title: Four Verbs of the Mind
label: ch:ta-verbs-of-the-mind
canDo: I can say I think, I understand, I read and I write in Tamil with the same three slots, tell a strong verb from a weak one by its held consonant, explain why எனக்குப் புரிகிறது has no I in it, and make the ழ in எழுது.

payoff.summary: Say நான் தமிழ் எழுதுகிறேன், run the chapter's four verbs in the present and sort them into strong and weak, produce ழ without letting the tongue touch, and name the one word here whose origin is unsettled.
